Supplementing GTC clause 6.0(ii) with the following: (a) Detailed Evaluation Criteria is as following: Bids for hiring of vehicles are being invited based on A + B + C model, where ‘A’ is monthly wage of the Driver as per Minimum Wages criteria of Central Govt/ State Govt(whiche ver is higher) as per notified minimum wages circular on Dt 30/03/2026 plus statutory expenses to be inc urred on EPF, EDLI, Admin. Charges, ESI and bonus as illustrated at Annexure-1 of Price_Schedule which is Rs.27567.30/month. ‘B’ is fixed monthly Vehicle rental Charges and ‘C’ is monthly Fuel Consumption Charges which is Rs.24860/- considering diesel rate as Rs.99.64 /li 3000 KM /Month tre prevailing on Dt. 21/07/2026 with tentative running of and Fuel consumpt ion mileage as 12 KMs per litre. ** GST@5% only applicable for A &B .GST already included in Fuel therefore Extra GST not ap plicable for C. Bidders are requested to quote total monthly charges for vehicle hiring considering driver cha rges in skilled category (as per component A above), cost towards fixed monthly vehicle rental (Component B) and cost towards fuel charges (as per component C above). A minimum floor price of Rs.53,805.67/- including GST@5% considering pre-specified cost of componen ts A and C as above has been kept. The differential between Bidder’s quoted price and the minim um floor price shall be towards component B i.e. fixed monthly vehicle rental charges. (b) Bidders are requested to quote the price in GeM portal itself. The Bid Prices quoted by the bidders cover all the Contractor’s obligations mentioned in or to be reaso nably inferred from the Bidding Documents to successfully execute the intended services, on a “Single Responsibility” basis. Bidders are required to quote the price for the commercial, contractual, and tech nical obligations outlined in the Bidding Documents. Bidders are required to quote total charges including GST Where the Bidder does not charge GST under Forward Charge Mechanism (FCM) and GST is applicable under Reverse Charge Mechanism (RCM), the applicable GST under RCM shall be considered and adde d to the quoted price for bid evaluation purposes only. Further, the Financial Document indicating detailed price break-up shall be obtained from the bidder to ascertain the applicable GST structure and mechanism (FCM/RCM) for evalua tion and compliance purposes.
